rules.name: high-cpu
rules.task_template: Investigate high CPU usage on {entity}. Current: {value}%. Identify the top processes and report whether any action is needed. Do NOT kill any process without reporting.

rules.name: high-memory
rules.task_template: Investigate high memory usage on {entity}. Current: {value}%. List the top memory consumers and report.

rules.name: disk-near-full
rules.task_template: Disk {entity} is {value}% full. Identify the largest directories/files causing usage and report cleanup options. Do NOT delete anything.

rules.name: ssh-brute-force
rules.task_template: Multiple authentication failures detected from {entity}: {message}. Check recent login history and report whether this looks like a brute-force attempt. Do NOT block anything.

rules.name: netapp-volume-capacity
rules.task_template: NetApp volume {entity} is at {value}% capacity. List the volume details and qtrees, and report which are the largest consumers.

rules.name: critical-anything
rules.task_template: CRITICAL event from {source} on {entity}: {message}. Investigate immediately and report findings. Take no irreversible action.
